about: The link each devya.dev project page lists for the project itself (its live app or repository), keyed by the page's slug (https://www.devya.dev/projects/<slug>). Every post about a project carries this link plus a devya.dev link, both UTM-tagged (render/seo.mjs requiredLinkProblems). validate.mjs --live checks that each page still lists its link. A project page that lists no link of its own (moving-pos-film, a film) uses the day's video instead.
